title: The isomorphic section-projection problem for convex bodies
summary: Let $K, L$ be convex bodies in $\mathbb{R}^n$ with $K$ centered. Assume that $|K \cap θ^{\perp}| \le |L|θ^{\perp}|$ for all $θ\in S^{n-1}$. We prove that $|K| \le c\sqrt{n}|L|$, which is sharp up to the choice of the absolute constant. The result gives the sharp isomorphic order in a mixed section-projection comparison problem, complementing the isomorphic Busemann-Petty and Shephard problems. It also removes the John's position assumption from an earlier result of the author, up to an absolute constant factor.
